v2 post-triage remediation (2026-10-19): the formal pass-2 query produced 0 alerts and missed the project's real vulnerability (unsafe YAML deserialization at multimodal/src/autogluon/multimodal/predictor.py:1124, _top_k_average, fixed by upstream commit 23a37e7 'load --> safe_load'). The v1 sink model covered only subprocess.check_output(shell=True) in sync_remote and the v1 source model only sync_remote environment variables, so the deserialization path was invisible (the open() read sat among the 6453 role=none entries). Informed by the fix-commit reference supplied by the operator for this remediation round, 1 source entry (p2-supp-004: open() file-content read at predictor.py:1123) and 1 sink entry (p2-sink-013: yaml.load(..., Loader=yaml.Loader) at predictor.py:1124) were added, MySources/MySinks extended, and the pass re-analyzed into results/pass2.sarif. IMPORTANT: line numbers are CodeQL-DB-version lines (DB created at the vulnerable parent sha 1a62b445); the disk working tree is checked out at the fixed commit 23a37e7. Originals of all modified files are preserved in backup_v1/.
